info.title: HomeServe API
info.description:
HomeServe Technologies booking API.

This page is the live Swagger UI. ReDoc is at `/redoc`. The spec file is `/openapi.json`. A short link is `/swagger`.

1. Call **POST /api/auth/login**.
2. Copy the `token` field.
3. Click **Authorize** and paste that token.
4. Try any endpoint. The request goes to this same server.

Demo password for every seeded account: `Demo@1234`.
